# Timer:persistent

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the timer persistent attribute.

```lua
local persistent = timer:persistent([persistent])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `persistent` | boolean | optional |  |

## Returns

persistent (boolean)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
timer = model.getTimer(0)
timer:persistent(true)
```
